slides.texte_overlay:
8 situations to stay silent
at all costs

1.
Be silent when you're angry
and about to hit send.

2.
Be silent when someone
shares good news.
Don't top it. Celebrate it.

3.
Be silent when the secret
isn't yours to tell.

4.
Be silent when someone
apologizes. Just accept it.

5.
Be silent when you're about
to complain for the third time.

6.
Be silent when people have
already decided about you.
Let time explain.

7.
Be silent at a funeral
unless you have something
kind to say.

8.
Be silent when someone
knows more than you.
Listen. Then go learn it.
